profile.headline: Sr Software Developer - Core Technologies & Cloud Video at Adobe
profile.summary:
Over 20 years of experience as a Sr. Architect and Sr. Full Stack Engineer in C, C++, Typescript, JavaScript, C#, React, Python, Node.js, AWS, Docker, Machine Learning, Agentic AI, MCP, RAG, CDN, WebAssembly, WebRTC, WebSocket, DevOps, Autoscaling, RDS Serverless, Microservices, Disaster Recovery, Blue/Green Deployments, Data Caching, Networking, Java, Android, iOS, MacOS, Cyber Attack preventions and many more ..

Global Innovation top winner, hobbies including more than 50 home automation project using IoT and microcontrollers

positions.title: Senior Software Developer - Cloud Video
positions.description: Responsible for crafting and improving Adobe's  world class technology stack to deliver cloud-based, collaborative video editing solutions using C, C++, Python, TypeScript, Node.js and JavaScript code for the Mac and Windows platforms. Build new features and services for Premiere Pro, After Effects and Premiere Rush. Work closely with a senior team of engineers, developers, designers and product managers who live and breath all things video and cloud. Responsible for solving problems that arise and to continually improve and enhance the system and product quality

positions.title: Software Engineering Manager
positions.description: Awarded top winner for innovative ideas in 2019 and 2020. Engineered end-to-end production, testing, and development stacks leveraging Infrastructure as Code principles, fortified with robust security measures, auto-scaling policies, and containerization via Docker. Implemented CDN and edge network solutions alongside DevOps methodologies, including blue-green deployment strategies and automated live backup systems with disaster recovery capabilities in hot mode. Architected micro-services infrastructure, featuring a relational database with multi-region master and child nodes, supported by asynchronous backups. Deployed NOSQL databases for reliable data storage and integrated Redis caching for optimized performance. Additionally, proficient in developing iOS, macOS, and Android applications, desktop software, as well as expertise in technologies like WebRTC, web sockets, and the creation of npm libraries. Skilled in languages such as C#, Typescript, JavaScript, C++, Swift, Java, Node.js, and Python.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), C# and +10 skills

positions.title: Sr. Solution Architect
positions.description: As the architect and designer, I conceptualized and developed numerous core components of the product. Leveraging a suite of JavaScript libraries, I orchestrated a robust .NET C# backend API complemented by caching services. I crafted intuitive UI/UX experiences utilizing Angular and React.js frameworks. Additionally, I engineered several desktop tools and applications, seamlessly integrating hardware peripherals such as printers, cameras, and biometric devices through SDKs and APIs, alongside system-level programming.

positions.title: Sr. Solution Architect
positions.description: Started with the company during its startup phase, eventually acquired by HID Global. My role encompassed a diverse spectrum of software development responsibilities, spanning across various domains. This included pioneering efforts in developing a proprietary UI framework, seamlessly integrating devices into websites, and orchestrating front-end middleware and backend systems with robust support for multiple databases. Additionally, I actively engaged in customer support and post-deployment activities, ensuring a seamless user experience throughout.

company.name: Quantum Secure, part of HID Global

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Deltager AS stands as Norway's premier self-registration portal for online registrations, with its headquarters situated in Oslo. My primary focus encompassed driving automation initiatives, spearheading UI development, executing UI upgrades, crafting migration scripts, and overseeing database operations. Through these efforts, we ensured seamless user experiences and operational efficiency.
positions.insights: JavaScript, Active Server Pages (ASP) and +4 skills
